t: A pocket computer with a tiny keyboard, color screen, and battery built in.
steps: Buy the Cardputer-Adv from the M5Stack Store for about 29.90 US dollars, or from RobotShop or DigiKey in the US.
Turn the power switch on and charge it with a USB-C cable. The switch must stay on for charging to work.
Open the UiFlow2 web editor from M5Stack and connect the Cardputer.
Drag a block that writes "Hello" on the screen and run it.
Try the factory demo apps for the keyboard, speaker and microphone.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the M5Cardputer library for text-based coding.
Upload a library example. Enter download mode by holding the G0 button as you plug in USB-C.
meta: Open Board. From $29.90. A few stores.
